name: Akiyoshi Tamae
source:
Always smiling and laughing. Calm and easy-going.

She can stare at the sky for an hour.

Her nicknames are Tama-chan or Kyuu-chan.

She often takes naps in her dive base (her own room).

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/akiba/charashokai/tamae.htm]official site[/url]]
